Proforma.description: A proforma invoice that can be converted to a final invoice.

status.description: Proforma lifecycle status (draft, accepted, rejected, cancelled, expired, converted).

price_list_id.description: UUID of the price list selected for this document.

price_list_name.description: Price-list name snapshot frozen on the document.

validity_days.description: Number of validity days of the proforma since its issuance. `null` if not applicable.

reference.description: Free reference of the document (e.g. the customer order number).

converted_to_id.description: UUID (v7) of the invoice this proforma was converted into, if applicable.

converted_invoice_number.description: Human-readable number of the invoice this proforma was converted into (e.g. "F-2026-00042"). `null` if not converted.

taxes_total.description: NET aggregate of the header taxes: `total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention`. It is the amount that, added to `subtotal`, yields `total` (`total === subtotal + taxes_total`), so it must NOT be combined with `total_retention`: subtracting the withholding again on top of the aggregate produces a false total (4,320.00 + 259.20 − 648.00 = 3,931.20 against a real total of 4,579.20). It is NOT the VAT figure of the Spanish Modelo 303 — read `total_vat` for that. Beware that on a purchase invoice the same field name carries a DIFFERENT meaning (VAT only), which is why the identity that holds across all five document families is the explicit one: `total === subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention`.

total_vat.description: Sum of the VAT of all lines.

total_retention.description: Sum of the withholding (IRPF) of all lines.

total_surcharge.description: Sum of the equivalence surcharge of all lines.

total.description: Total of the document. Two equivalent ways to reconstruct it from the published amounts, and only these two: the EXPLICIT one, identical in the five document families - `total = subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge - total_retention` - or the AGGREGATE one, specific to the sales-side families - `total = subtotal + taxes_total`. NEVER reconstruct it as `subtotal + taxes_total - total_retention`: `taxes_total` ALREADY has the withholding netted out, so that combination subtracts it twice and yields a false total (4,320.00 + 259.20 - 648.00 = 3,931.20 against a real 4,579.20).

shipping_cost.description: Additional shipping cost added to the total.

total_with_shipping.description: Final total including the shipping cost (= total + shipping_cost).

payment_method.description: Preferred payment method (backing value of the Shared enum `PaymentMethod`, e.g. `bank_transfer`).

payment_terms_days.description: Payment term in days (Net X). Valid range: 0-365.

delivery_terms.description: Condiciones de entrega en formato libre.
delivery_terms.example: Entrega en 5 dias habiles, portes incluidos
examples: Entrega en 5 dias habiles, portes incluidos

terms_and_conditions.description: Terms and conditions rendered in the proforma PDF.

examples: Validez 30 dias. Proforma sin valor fiscal hasta su conversion en factura.

Free-format, unique per company, filterable via `?external_id=`. `null` when not set. Persistent synchronization key, independent of the request-level `Idempotency-Key`.

custom_fields.description: Ordered list of typed custom fields `[{field, value}]` (≤ 50). Distinct from `metadata` (a free key→value map): use `custom_fields` for structured, display-oriented integration metadata. Empty `[]` when there are none.

link_expires_at.description: Expiration date of the shareable public link, or `null` if unlimited.

description.example: Setup inicial

additional_description.description: Optional secondary description rendered below the line concept on document PDFs.
additional_description.example: Auditoría inicial e informe de mejoras

retention_rate.description: IRPF withholding percentage applied to the line (0–100). Default 0. Its amount is already aggregated into `taxes`.

surcharge_rate.description: Equivalence surcharge (recargo de equivalencia) percentage applied to the line (0–100). Default 0. Its amount is already aggregated into `taxes`.

indirect_tax_regime.description: Indirect tax regime of the line: the per-document override (`iva`/`igic`/`ipsi`) when the user set it (precedence override>zone), otherwise `null` (derived from the establishment AEAT zone). Writable per-document input on create/update; the document must be homogeneous (a single non-null regime across all lines, 422 otherwise).

configuration.description: Commercial combination frozen on the line, or `null` when the line was not sold or bought through one (legacy product, manual line).

options.description: Configurable options frozen on the line, in printing order. Always an array, `[]` included.

price_adjustment.description: Adjustment of the chosen value per commercial unit. `null` means the value does not change the price — NOT the same as adjusting by `0`.

applied.description: Whether that amount was actually ADDED to the unit price. `false` when an exact price (price-list entry, combination price or a manually typed unit price) already absorbed it.

price_semantics.description: Monetary semantics of the resolved price: `per_base_unit` (product/variant own price, converted once by the presentation factor) or `per_commercial_unit` (presentation, combination or price-list entry, never converted). `null` on a line with no catalog price context.

price_adjustment_total.description: Sum of the adjustments of the chosen option values, as a decimal string. Informational when an exact price already absorbed them.

option_adjustments_absorbed.description: TRI-STATE, and `null` is NOT `false`. `true`: the resolved price already includes the option adjustments. `false`: they were added on top. `null`: it could not be determined — the assembler refuses such a line with 422 rather than risking charging the adjustments twice, so `null` only ever reaches a reader on a legacy line with no configurable options at all.

PurchaseInvoice.description: An invoice received from a supplier.

external_invoice_number.description: The number assigned by the supplier on their invoice. `null` for a simplified expense ticket (`is_simplified`) with no supplier number.

is_simplified.description: Whether this is a simplified purchase invoice (expense ticket). When `true`, `supplier` and `external_invoice_number` may be `null`.

external_id.description: External integration key (ERP/CRM/e-commerce) mapping this document to a record in a third-party system. Free-format, unique per company, filterable via `?external_id=`. `null` when not set. Persistent synchronization key, independent of the request-level `Idempotency-Key`.

internal_code.description: Optional internal code assigned by the company for its own classification.

received_on.description: Reception date of the invoice, or `null`.

taxes_total.description: VAT BORNE (IVA soportado) of this purchase invoice, WITHOUT surcharge and WITHOUT withholding. Careful: on the sales-side documents (invoice, delivery note, quote, proforma) the SAME field name carries the NET aggregate `total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention` instead. Header invariant here: `total === subtotal + taxes_total + total_surcharge − total_retention`. Read `total_vat` for a VAT figure whose meaning does not depend on the document family.

total_vat.description: Same VAT amount as `taxes_total`, published under the name the concept carries in the other four document families, so that the explicit identity `total === subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention` holds across all five without knowing which resource produced the body.

total_retention.description: Aggregated IRPF withholding of the lines (Σ retention_amount). Header invariant: `total === subtotal + taxes_total + total_surcharge − total_retention`.

total_surcharge.description: Aggregated equivalence surcharge of the lines (Σ surcharge_amount). It adds to the total exactly like VAT does, so it is part of the header invariant above.

total.description: Total of the purchase invoice. Two equivalent ways to reconstruct it from the published amounts, and only these two: the EXPLICIT one, identical in the five document families - `total = subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge - total_retention` - or the one specific to this family, where `taxes_total` is the VAT alone - `total = subtotal + taxes_total + total_surcharge - total_retention`. Note that the aggregate shortcut of the sales-side families (`subtotal + taxes_total`) does NOT apply here: the same field name carries a different meaning on each side.

paid_amount.description: Amount already paid against this purchase invoice (derived from the payment ledger). Satisfies the invariant `paid_amount + pending_amount === total`.

pending_amount.description: Outstanding balance pending payment for this purchase invoice (derived from the payment ledger).

payment_status.description: Derived payment status, NOT a persisted domain state (the model keeps 4 statuses). `overdue` derives from `pending` + `due_date < today` and prevails in presentation.

payment_terms_days.description: Payment term days agreed with the supplier, or `null`.

bank_account.description: Supplier bank account. Always `null` in this version (accounts live embedded as JSON in `suppliers` without a stable identity). Follow-up `bridge-bank-account-cross-bc-supplier` will expose it as an object once Supplier promotes a read port.

expense_account.description: Cuenta contable de gasto asociada, o `null`.

expense_category_id.description: UUID (v7) of the associated expense category, or `null`.

deductible_percentage.description: Deductible percentage of the input VAT (0–100), or `null` when not set.

operation_class.description: Operation class for the input VAT of Modelo 303. Defaults to `corriente`. `isp` (domestic reverse charge, Art. 84.Uno.2 LIVA) and `intracomunitaria` are self-assessed: the buyer declares both the output VAT and the deductible input VAT.

exclude_347.description: Declarative per-document flag: whether this purchase invoice is excluded from the annual Modelo 347 report.

is_reverse_charge.description: Indicates whether the invoice is subject to reverse charge.

tags.description: Free classification tags (lowercase slugs `[a-z0-9-]`, ≤ 40 chars each, ≤ 30 tags). Filterable via `?tags[in]=tag1,tag2` (JSON_CONTAINS, OR semantics). Empty `[]` when there are none.

custom_fields.description: Ordered list of typed custom fields `[{field, value}]` (≤ 50). Distinct from `metadata` (a free key→value map): use `custom_fields` for structured, display-oriented integration metadata. Empty `[]` when there are none.

internal_notes.description: Internal notes not visible to the supplier, or `null`.
internal_notes.example: Revisar con contabilidad antes del cierre trimestral.
examples: Revisar con contabilidad antes del cierre trimestral.

PurchaseInvoiceLine.description: A line item on a purchase invoice.

description.example: Material oficina pedido Q1

additional_description.description: Optional secondary description rendered below the line concept on document PDFs.

retention_rate.description: IRPF withholding percentage applied to the supplier (0–100). Default 0.

surcharge_rate.description: Equivalence surcharge (recargo de equivalencia) percentage paid to the retail supplier (0–100). Default 0. Only the legal VAT-surcharge pairs are accepted (21→5.2, 10→1.4, 4→0.5).

retention_amount.description: Withholding amount of the line (`subtotal * retention_rate / 100`). The line total follows `subtotal + taxes − retention_amount + surcharge_amount`.

surcharge_amount.description: Equivalence surcharge amount of the line (`subtotal * surcharge_rate / 100`). Default 0.

taxes_total.description: NET aggregate of the header taxes: `total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention`. It is the amount that, added to `subtotal`, yields `total` (`total === subtotal + taxes_total`), so it must NOT be combined with `total_retention`: subtracting the withholding again on top of the aggregate produces a false total (4,320.00 + 259.20 − 648.00 = 3,931.20 against a real total of 4,579.20). It is NOT the VAT figure of the Spanish Modelo 303 — read `total_vat` for that. Beware that on a purchase invoice the same field name carries a DIFFERENT meaning (VAT only), which is why the identity that holds across all five document families is the explicit one: `total === subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention`.

total_vat.description: Sum of VAT (IVA) across all lines.

total_retention.description: Sum of withholding (IRPF/retention) across all lines.

total_surcharge.description: Sum of equivalence surcharge (recargo de equivalencia) across all lines.

total.description: Total of the document. Two equivalent ways to reconstruct it from the published amounts, and only these two: the EXPLICIT one, identical in the five document families - `total = subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge - total_retention` - or the AGGREGATE one, specific to the sales-side families - `total = subtotal + taxes_total`. NEVER reconstruct it as `subtotal + taxes_total - total_retention`: `taxes_total` ALREADY has the withholding netted out, so that combination subtracts it twice and yields a false total (4,320.00 + 259.20 - 648.00 = 3,931.20 against a real 4,579.20).

taxes_total.description: NET aggregate of the header taxes: `total_vat + total_surcharge - total_retention`. It is the amount that, added to `subtotal`, yields `total` (`total === subtotal + taxes_total`), so it must NOT be combined with `total_retention`: subtracting the withholding again on top of the aggregate produces a false total. It is NOT the VAT figure of the Spanish Modelo 303 - read `total_vat` for that. These amounts are a PREVIEW aggregated from the template lines (the recurrence persists no header totals), rounded per line exactly as the invoice it will issue stores them.

total_vat.description: Output VAT (IVA repercutido) the recurrence will accrue: sum of the VAT of its template lines. This is the figure a Spanish Modelo 303 declares, and it is NOT recoverable from `taxes_total`, which nets the withholding out.

total_retention.description: Withholding (retencion de IRPF) the recurrence will apply: sum of the withholding of its template lines, as a POSITIVE amount that SUBTRACTS from the total. This is the figure a Spanish Modelo 130/111 declares. It is ALREADY netted out inside `taxes_total`, so do not subtract it again.

total_surcharge.description: Equivalence surcharge (recargo de equivalencia) of the template lines. It ADDS to the total exactly like VAT does, and is ALREADY included inside `taxes_total`.

total.description: Total the recurrence will invoice. Two equivalent ways to reconstruct it from the published amounts, and only these two: the EXPLICIT one, identical in the six document families - `total = subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge - total_retention` - or the AGGREGATE one, specific to the sales-side families - `total = subtotal + taxes_total`. NEVER reconstruct it as `subtotal + taxes_total - total_retention`: `taxes_total` ALREADY has the withholding netted out, so that combination subtracts it twice.

external_id.description: External integration key (ERP/CRM/e-commerce) mapping this document to a record in a third-party system. Series.description: A document numbering series. Immutable per AEAT compliance.

prefix.description: Legacy alias for code. Use code field. Will be removed in v2.

number_format.description: Canonical numbering mask describing how the document number is rendered: padding (the block of zeros), year token (`{YYYY}` 4 digits / `{YY}` 2 digits / omitted for no year), optional month token (`{MM}` 2 digits) and separator. Example: `{code}-{YYYY}-{000}` (default) or `{code}-{YYYY}-{00000}` for 5-digit padding. When `counter_reset` is `monthly`, the mask must include the `{MM}` token (e.g. `F-{YYYY}-{MM}-{000}`) so the rendered number stays unique across months; otherwise two months would both start at `1`. Set on creation and immutable afterwards. Mirrors Holded's `format`.

next_number.description: Next correlative that will be assigned on the next real emission.

current_number.description: Last correlative actually emitted in the current fiscal year (0 for a brand-new series).

initial_number.description: Number the counter starts from. Set on creation to continue an existing numbering when migrating (e.g. 235). Defaults to 1.

counter_reset.description: Counter reset policy (source of truth): `never` (the counter never resets), `annual` (resets on January 1st) or `monthly` (resets on the 1st of each month). `monthly` requires the `number_format` mask to include the `{MM}` token to keep rendered numbers unique across months.

year_reset.description: Deprecated alias of `counter_reset`. `true` is equivalent to `counter_reset: "annual"`, `false` to `counter_reset: "never"`. Use `counter_reset` instead; this field will be removed in v2.

Series.title: Series

SeriesActivity.description: An event in the activity timeline of a numbering series. Groups domain events originated by changes to the series itself (creation, archive/unarchive, marked as default, number consumption).

event_type.description: Tipo de evento de dominio (p. ej. `series.created`, `series.archived`, `series.number_consumed`).

description.description: Human-readable description of the event in Spanish.

type.description: Type of actor that originated the event: `user` for a human in the internal app, `api_key` for an action performed through the public v1 API.

id.description: UUID (v7) of the actor: the user when `type=user`, or the API key when `type=api_key`.

name.description: Actor name at the time of the event: the user name or the API key name. `null` if it could not be resolved.

performed_by.description: Actor that originated the event. `{type:"user",...}` for an internal user, `{type:"api_key",...}` when performed via the public v1 API, or `null` when the event is system-generated (scheduler, periodic sweep) with no attributable actor.

SeriesBootstrapEntry.description: Outcome of the bootstrap for one document type. The three states describe different business situations, not cosmetic variants: `created` and `existing` leave the type ready to issue documents, `no_default` does not.

document_type.description: Document type this entry reports on. The `contract` type is outside the public surface and is never bootstrapped.

status.description: `created`: the type had no active series and its default one was created. `existing`: it already had a default series and nothing was touched. `no_default`: it has active series but none marked as default — nothing was created and nothing was promoted.

series_id.description: Opaque identifier (UUID v7) of the resulting default series. `null` only on `no_default`, where there is no default series to point at.

code.description: Code of the resulting default series (`F` invoices, `P` quotes, `ALB` delivery notes, `PRF` pro formas). `null` only on `no_default`.

candidates.description: Active series you can promote to default. Always present; empty except on `no_default`.

results.description: One entry per document type evaluated.

ShopifyConnectionCheck.description: The outcome of testing the connection with one of your connected Shopify stores. The public `id` is the UUID (v7) of the STORE that was tested, so you can tell which shop this diagnosis is about. Nothing is stored: this resource is a diagnosis, not a record. Read `reachable` and `credential_accepted` together — `reachable: false` means the shop did not answer, while `reachable: true` with `credential_accepted: false` means it answered and rejected the access token — and read `failure_code` for the concrete cause, which is what tells «your token is no longer valid» apart from «the Admin API version we speak has expired».

id.description: UUID (v7) of the store that was tested. Public identity (KEY `id`).

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `shopify_connection_check` for this resource.

reachable.description: Whether the shop answered at all. `false` covers a timeout, a transport failure, a 5xx from Shopify, an exhausted query cost budget and a destination your company has not authorised for outbound traffic.

credential_accepted.description: Whether the shop accepted the stored access token. Always `false` when `reachable` is `false`: we never got to ask.

store_version.description: The Shopify plan the shop reports, or `null` when it does not report one. Shopify publishes no «store version»; the plan display name is the closest equivalent it exposes. Informational: nothing is gated on it.

api_version.description: The pinned Admin API version this connector talked to the shop with (`YYYY-MM`), or `null` when it could not be resolved. It is OUR pin, not something the shop reports: Shopify serves whatever version you ask for and, once yours expires, silently falls forward to the oldest stable one with HTTP 200. Read it together with `supported_until`.

supported_until.description: The date the pinned Admin API version is supported until (ISO 8601 date), or `null` when there is no version to ask about or the version is not in our calendar. This is the field to watch: when an Admin API version expires Shopify does not fail, it answers 200 with the fields of another version, so the breakage is silent and shows up as data quietly going missing.

failure_code.description: Code naming the concrete cause when the check did not succeed, or `null` when it did. Today `shopify_store_unreachable` (the shop did not answer, or the query cost budget was exhausted — the only one worth retrying), `shopify_credentials_rejected` (the shop rejected the access token, or there was none to use), `shopify_api_version_expired` (the pinned Admin API version is no longer served) and `store_url_not_allowed` (your company has not authorised that destination for outbound traffic). Not an exhaustive enumeration: new causes may appear without a breaking change, so treat an unknown value as a failure you cannot classify.

checked_at.description: When the check ran (ISO 8601). Nothing is cached: every call tests the shop again.

ShopifyConnectionCheck.title: ShopifyConnectionCheck

StockMovement.description: One row of the append-only stock ledger of a product, from the most recently applied movement to the oldest. Lets an integration audit and reconcile inventory instead of only seeing the current balance.

delta.description: Signed change in BASE units, decimal string with scale 4. Positive = stock in, negative = stock out. Never zero.

stock_after.description: Balance right after this movement was applied, decimal string with scale 4. Derived from the COMPLETE ledger, so it does not change when `direction` hides the interleaved rows.

reason.description: Why the movement happened. Closed catalog: `invoice_sent`, `invoice_annulled`, `invoice_unsent`, `corrective_created`, `delivery_note_delivered`, `delivery_note_cancelled`, `purchase_invoice_registered`, `purchase_invoice_reverted`, `manual_adjustment`.

source_type.description: Kind of document that caused the movement. `manual` for an adjustment with no source document.

source_id.description: Id of the source document, `null` for a manual adjustment or when the document is no longer reachable.

source_label.description: Human-readable number of the source document.

performed_by.description: Name of the user who caused the movement. `null` means the system did.

base_unit_code.description: UN/ECE code of the unit `delta` and `stock_after` are measured in. Always present.

commercial_quantity.description: Commercial magnitude the delta came from, decimal string with scale 4. All-or-nothing with `commercial_unit_code` and `conversion_factor`.

commercial_unit_code.description: UN/ECE code of the commercial unit. All-or-nothing with `commercial_quantity` and `conversion_factor`.

conversion_factor.description: Base units per commercial unit, decimal string with scale 6. All-or-nothing with the other two. Informational: it is NOT applied again here.

variant_id.description: Managing variant the balance belongs to, `null` when it is the base product.

StockMovement.title: StockMovement

Store.description: A connected e-commerce store of your company. The public `id` is the store UUID (v7). `integration_id` is the UUID of the provider connection that backs it, and `external_store_id` is the identifier the provider gives to the shop — an opaque string, not a foreign key of ours. The settings decide how the orders of the store become invoices.

id.description: UUID (v7) of the store. Public identity (KEY `id`).

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `store` for this resource.

integration_id.description: UUID of the provider connection (integration) that backs the store. Several stores of the same provider may hang from one connection.

external_store_id.description: Identifier the provider gives to the shop. Unique per provider within your company; an opaque string, NOT a foreign key of ours.

name.description: Editable display name of the store.

simplified_threshold.description: Order total, in EUROS, up to which the store issues a simplified invoice (F2). Capped at 3000.00, the legal maximum. Defaults to 400.00, the general legal limit.

require_tax_id.description: Whether the buyer tax ID is required for an order to be invoiced. Defaults to `false`: a retail store sells to consumers who do not provide one.

prices_include_tax.description: Whether the prices of the store already include taxes. Defaults to `true`, which is how Spanish retail displays prices.

autoinvoicing_enabled.description: Whether paid orders are invoiced automatically. Defaults to `false`: a freshly connected store does not invoice on its own until you turn it on.

autosend_enabled.description: Whether the invoice is emailed to the buyer automatically. Defaults to `false`.

remote_base_url.description: Base address of the remote shop, or `null` when none is declared. Credentials embedded in the address are removed before it is returned.

environment.description: Environment the store reports as. `live` invoices for real; `test` discards its events with a typed reason. Defaults to `test`.

status.description: Store status. `active` while connected; `disconnected` after disconnecting.

connected_at.description: When the store was connected (ISO 8601), or `null` if unknown.

Store.title: Store

StripeAutoinvoicedCorrective.description: A corrective invoice automatically generated from a Stripe refund (`charge.refunded`). The public `id` is the UUID (v7) of the corrective invoice; `original_invoice_id` links to the original invoice.

id.description: UUID (v7) of the corrective invoice. Public identity (KEY `id`).

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `stripe_autoinvoiced_corrective` for this resource.

original_invoice_id.description: UUID (v7) of the original invoice that was corrected by the refund.

refund_id.description: Opaque refund identifier from the payment gateway (e.g. Stripe `re_xxx`).

provider.description: Payment gateway the refund originated from.

amount.description: Refunded amount in euros (the individual refund amount, not the cumulative).

correction_type.description: Scope of the correction: `total` (full annulment) or `partial` (a single negative line for the refunded amount).

created_at.description: When the corrective mapping was recorded (ISO 8601).

StripeAutoinvoicedPayment.description: A Stripe charge that generated an invoice (one-shot flows A/B and subscription cycles). The public `id` is the UUID (v7) of the payment; `invoice_id`/`client_id` link to the generated invoice and client. Subscription-origin context (`subscription_id`, `stripe_invoice_id`, `period_start`, `period_end`) is `null` for one-shot charges.

id.description: UUID (v7) of the payment record. Public identity (KEY `id`).

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `stripe_autoinvoiced_payment` for this resource.

invoice_id.description: UUID (v7) of the invoice generated by this charge.

client_id.description: UUID (v7) of the invoice client, or `null` if not available.

stripe_reference.description: Stripe transaction reference of the payment record.

subscription_id.description: External Stripe subscription id (`sub_xxx`) when the charge comes from a subscription cycle; `null` for one-shot charges. This is an external Stripe id, NOT an internal UUID.

stripe_invoice_id.description: Stripe invoice id (`in_xxx`) of the billed cycle; `null` for one-shot charges.

period_start.description: Start of the billed subscription period (YYYY-MM-DD); `null` for one-shot charges.

period_end.description: End of the billed subscription period (YYYY-MM-DD); `null` for one-shot charges.

created_at.description: When the payment record was created (ISO 8601).

updated_at.description: When the payment record was last updated (ISO 8601).

StripeAutoinvoicedPayment.title: StripeAutoinvoicedPayment

StripeAutoinvoicingConfig.description: Stripe Connect integration status and auto-invoicing configuration for your company. Singleton resource (one configuration per company), so it exposes `object` but no navigable `id`.

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `stripe_autoinvoicing_config` for this resource.

connected.description: Whether the Stripe Connect integration is connected (active) for the company.

enabled.description: Whether auto-invoicing of Stripe charges is enabled. Defaults to `false`.

series_id.description: UUID (v7) of the document series used for auto-created invoices. `null` means the company default series is used.

available_for_current_plan.description: Whether the current plan includes auto-invoicing (effective plan gating, derived from config — not hardcoded).

required_plans.description: Plans that unlock auto-invoicing (derived from config, not hardcoded).

simplified_threshold_cents.description: Simplified invoice (F2) threshold in cents, range `[0, 300000]` (0–3,000 €). Charges without a tax ID at or below this amount are auto-issued as simplified invoices; above it they are routed to manual review. Defaults to 40000 (400 €).

require_nif.description: Whether a Spanish tax ID (NIF) is required for auto-invoicing. When enabled, Factuarea-created Checkouts mark the tax ID as required and charges without a tax ID are never auto-issued as simplified invoices (they go to manual review). Defaults to `false`.

refunds_enabled.description: Whether a Stripe refund (`charge.refunded`) automatically generates a linked corrective invoice (with the original invoice and the VeriFactu R record). Only acts while auto-invoicing is enabled. Defaults to `true`.

subscription_autoinvoicing_enabled.description: Whether Stripe subscription cycles (`invoice.paid` with a standard `billing_reason`) are auto-invoiced. Both this toggle and the general `enabled` flag must be on for a cycle to be invoiced. Defaults to `false`.

StripeAutoinvoicingConfig.title: StripeAutoinvoicingConfig

StripePayout.description: A Stripe payout ingested from `payout.paid`, together with its bank-reconciliation state. The public `id` is the payout UUID (v7). `connected_account_id` (`acct_xxx`) and `stripe_payout_id` (`po_xxx`) are external Stripe ids, not foreign keys. `bank_transaction_ref` is the UUID (v7) of the reconciled bank statement transaction (`null` while `status` is `ingested`). `composition` is the informative breakdown reported by Stripe (component charges + fees), referencing opaque Stripe ids — payouts are read-only on the public API; reconciliation happens in the dashboard.

id.description: UUID (v7) of the payout. Public identity (KEY `id`).

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `stripe_payout` for this resource.

connected_account_id.description: External Stripe connected account id (`acct_xxx`) the payout was paid out from. NOT an internal UUID nor a foreign key.

stripe_payout_id.description: Opaque Stripe payout identifier (`po_xxx`), unique in Stripe.

amount_net.description: Net amount transferred to the bank account (gross minus fees), in the payout currency.

fee_total.description: Total Stripe fees deducted from the payout.

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code of the payout.

arrival_date.description: Expected arrival date of the payout in the bank account (YYYY-MM-DD).

status.description: Reconciliation state. `ingested` once persisted; `reconciled` (terminal) once matched against a bank statement transaction.

reconciled_at.description: When the payout was reconciled against the bank statement (ISO 8601), or `null` while `ingested`.

bank_transaction_ref.description: UUID (v7) of the reconciled bank statement transaction, or `null` while `ingested`.

composition.description: Informative breakdown of the payout reported by Stripe (component charges and fees). Component references are opaque Stripe ids (`payment_intent` = `pi_xxx`, `charge_id` = `ch_xxx`), NOT internal payment UUIDs. May be empty when the breakdown could not be read.

StripePayout.title: StripePayout

Supplier.description: A supplier or vendor of your company.

business_name.description: Legal/business name / full fiscal name of the supplier (may match `name`).

commercial_name.description: Optional trade name (DBA), distinct from the legal name.

tax_id.description: Spanish fiscal identifier (NIF, CIF, NIE). Structural format: NIF `^\d{8}[A-Z]$`, NIE `^[XYZ]\d{7}[A-Z]$`, CIF `^[A-Z]\d{7}[A-Z0-9]$`. coordinates.description: Geographic coordinates of the supplier. `null` when not recorded.

iban.description: Legacy alias for bank_accounts[].iban where is_default=true. Kept for backward compatibility with existing integrators; prefer reading `bank_accounts[]` for new consumers.

offers_count.description: Number of catalog supplier offers linked to this supplier.

related_products_count.description: Number of distinct products linked through supplier offers.

offers_filter.description: Filter to list the supplier offers owned by this supplier.

Tax.description: A tax rate configuration. Catalog partially global (`is_system=true` for system taxes, without `company_id`) and partially custom per company.

name.description: Human-readable name of the tax (e.g. "IVA 21%").

rate.description: Applied tax rate, e.g. `21` for 21% VAT.

applies_to.description: Scope where it applies: `sales` (sales only), `purchases` (purchases only), `both` (both).

is_default.description: true if this is the default tax for its `type` (independent of the `default_for_documents` map).

is_active.description: Indicates whether the tax is enabled for use on new documents.

is_system.description: true if the tax is from the global system catalog (not editable, without `company_id`).

description.example: IVA general aplicable en territorio peninsular y Baleares.
examples: IVA general aplicable en territorio peninsular y Baleares.

default_for_documents.description: Map `DocumentType -> bool` indicating for which document types this tax is default. Replaces the 5 legacy booleans `is_default_invoice/quote/delivery_note/proforma/purchase_invoice`.

customer_visible_label.description: Tax label shown to the end customer on documents (PDF, public link, email).

linked_surcharge_taxes_id.description: Identity (UUID v7) of the linked equivalence-surcharge tax. Foreign key to the global `taxes` table (key suffix `_taxes_id` per the UUID policy). `null` when there is no link.

tax_rate.description: Applied tax rate, e.g. `21` for 21% VAT.

TaxCatalog.description: The Spanish tax catalog as a single document: indirect tax regimes with their legal rates and VeriFactu code, header-level operation regimes, exemption causes with their article and legal wording, system withholding rates, and the legal VAT/equivalence-surcharge pairs. It carries no data of the authenticated company, so two different companies receive byte-identical bodies for the same language, and it is not an entity: it has no `id` and no `object`.

primary_language.description: Language resolved from `Accept-Language` (`es`, `en` or `ca`; `es` when the header is absent or names no supported language). It declares the primary language of the document; it does not filter it — every entry always carries all three translations. It travels inside the body on purpose, which is why two languages yield different `ETag`s.

indirect_tax_regimes.description: Indirect tax regimes (IVA, IGIC, IPSI) with their legal rates, standard rate, VeriFactu L1 code and the AEAT zones that determine each one.

operation_regimes.description: Header-level operation regimes with the legal wording each one requires and whether it forces a zero VAT amount.

exemption_causes.description: Exemption, non-subjection and special-regime causes with their AEAT codes, legal wording, applicable article and whether they can be declared per line.

retention_rates.description: System withholding rates, expressed in positive. Mostly IRPF withholdings, plus one contractual retainer that is not a tax and one IRNR rate (see the entry schema). The catalog of what the platform offers, not an exhaustive list of every rate Spanish law defines.

equivalence_surcharge_pairs.description: Closed matrix of the legal VAT/equivalence-surcharge pairs of article 161 of the Spanish VAT Act.

TaxCatalog.title: TaxCatalog

TaxCatalogExemptionCause.description: An exemption, non-subjection or special-regime cause, with the AEAT code it projects to, the legal wording the invoice must carry and the article of the Spanish VAT Act (Ley 37/1992) it relies on. The three AEAT codes are mutually exclusive: every cause derives at most one of them, and the other two are `null`.

calificacion_operacion.description: Code of the AEAT L9 list (transaction qualification): `S2` for reverse charge, `N1`/`N2` for the two non-subjection cases. `null` when the cause is an exemption or a special regime.

causa_exencion.description: Code of the AEAT L10 list (exemption reason), `E1` to `E6`. `null` when the cause is not an exemption.

clave_regimen.description: Code of the AEAT L8A/L8B list (special regime key): `19` farming, `03` second-hand goods, `05` travel agencies, `51` equivalence surcharge, `07` cash accounting. `null` when no special regime applies.

legal_mention.example: Operación intracomunitaria sujeta y exenta conforme al artículo 25 de la Ley 37/1992.
legal_mention.description: Full legal wording (in Spanish) that the invoice must carry when this cause is declared.

article.description: Article of the Spanish VAT Act (Ley 37/1992) the cause relies on. `null` only for `otro`, whose wording is written by hand and has no determined article — `null` means "no article", never "not mapped".

line_level.description: `true` when the cause can be declared per invoice line (its projected code is one of `E1`-`E6`, `N1`, `N2`). `false` for the special regimes, `otro` and reverse charge, which can only be declared in the document header.

TaxCatalogExemptionCause.title: TaxCatalogExemptionCause

TaxCatalogIndirectRegime.description: An indirect tax regime determined by the territory the issuer operates from (IVA on the mainland and the Balearic Islands, IGIC in the Canary Islands, IPSI in Ceuta and Melilla). This is the "which tax applies" axis; it is orthogonal to the operation regime, which answers "how is this transaction taxed".

aeat_code.description: Code of the AEAT L1 list used by VeriFactu: `01` for IVA, `02` for IPSI, `03` for IGIC. Send this value, not the `code`, when a VeriFactu field expects the L1 list.

valid_rates.description: Every legal rate of the regime, in percentage points. Any other rate is rejected when the invoice line is created.

general_rate.description: Standard rate of the regime, the sensible default when the line has no explicit rate.

aeat_zones.description: AEAT territorial zones that determine this regime. A company whose zone is listed here charges this tax.

TaxCatalogIndirectRegime.title: TaxCatalogIndirectRegime

TaxCatalogLocalizedText.description: A catalog text in the three languages the API supports. All three are always present: the negotiated `Accept-Language` picks the primary language of the document, it never filters the payload, so a client rendering a multilingual selector does not need three requests.
TaxCatalogLocalizedText.title: TaxCatalogLocalizedText

TaxCatalogOperationRegime.description: A header-level operation regime: how a transaction is taxed regardless of which indirect tax applies. Three of the four require the invoice to be issued with no VAT amount and to carry a legal wording; sending a rate above zero on those is a fiscal error, not a formatting one.

code.description: Stable identifier of the operation regime.

legal_mention.example: Operación intracomunitaria sujeta y exenta - Art. 25 LIVA
legal_mention.description: Legal wording (in Spanish) that the invoice must carry for this regime. `null` for `general`, the ordinary domestic transaction, which requires none.

requires_zero_vat.description: `true` when the regime forces a zero VAT amount on every line of the document.

TaxCatalogOperationRegime.title: TaxCatalogOperationRegime

TaxCatalogRetentionRate.description: A system withholding rate offered by the platform. Most entries are IRPF withholdings, but not all of them, and the `IRPF_` prefix of the `code` is no proof otherwise — codes are stable identifiers, not a tax classification. Two entries are not IRPF: `IRPF_5_GARANTIA` is contractual retention money on a construction contract, with no tax nature at all (it is not reported on form 111 and nothing is paid over to AEAT), and `IRPF_24` belongs to IRNR (RDL 5/2004), the non-resident income tax. Read each `label` for the nature of its own rate instead of assuming every entry is an IRPF withholding. This block is the catalog of what Factuarea ships, NOT an exhaustive list of every rate Spanish law defines, and it never includes the custom taxes a company creates through `POST /v1/taxes`.

code.description: Stable identifier of the withholding type. It is the key, not the `rate`: two different types can share the same percentage and `applies_to` and differ only in the case they cover.

rate.description: Withholding percentage, always POSITIVE. Apply it as a deduction from the taxable base; the sign convention of the contract is positive regardless of how the rate is stored internally.

applies_to.description: `sale` for withholdings you apply on your own invoices, `purchase` for withholdings a supplier applies on theirs.

TaxCatalogRetentionRate.title: TaxCatalogRetentionRate

TaxCatalogSurchargePair.description: A legal pairing of a VAT rate with its equivalence surcharge (recargo de equivalencia). The rates are the ones article 161 of the Spanish VAT Act (Ley 37/1992) fixes; article 154, which anchors the special regime, governs its content and not its rates. The matrix is closed: any other combination is rejected when the invoice line is created. It pairs a surcharge with a VAT rate, so it cannot express the 1.75% rate article 161 reserves for supplies of manufactured tobacco, which depends on the product and not on the VAT rate.

vat.description: VAT rate of the pair, in percentage points.

surcharge.description: Equivalence surcharge that legally accompanies that VAT rate.

TaxCatalogSurchargePair.title: TaxCatalogSurchargePair

TaxDefaultsForDocuments.description: Defaults grouped by tax category for a given document type. Each key contains the (possibly empty) list of taxes marked as default for that `docType` within its `type`.

vat.description: Taxes with `type=vat` that are default for the requested docType.

TaxDefaultsForDocuments.title: TaxDefaultsForDocuments

TaxReport.description: A generated Spanish tax declaration (Modelo 303 quarterly VAT, or Modelo 347 yearly informational). Downloadable via `GET /v1/tax_reports/{uuid}/download`.

id.description: Opaque UUID (v7) of the generated report.

period_year.description: Fiscal year covered by the declaration (backward compat, also available in `period.year`).

period_quarter.description: Quarter (1-4) for Modelo 303; null for Modelo 347 (yearly). Backward compat, also available in `period.quarter`.

period.description: Fiscal period covered by the declaration (nested form).

format.description: Output format. `txt_aeat` is the official format accepted by the AEAT submission portal.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the generated file (audit trail).

generated_by_id.description: UUID (v7) of the user who generated the declaration (audit trail).

download_url.description: Relative download URL of the generated resource (`/v1/tax_reports/{uuid}/download`).

warnings.description: Non-blocking warnings emitted during generation (e.g. invoices with incomplete data).

warning_codes.description: Stable machine-readable codes paired one-to-one (same index) with `warnings`. Branch on these instead of matching the Spanish text; unknown codes should fall back to the corresponding `warnings` entry.

TaxReport.title: TaxReport

TaxReportActivity.description: An event in the activity timeline of a tax report generation (creation, download, etc.). The `metadata` is sanitized (internal PKs removed) before being exposed.

event_type.description: Tipo de evento de dominio (p. ej. `tax_report.generated`).

description.description: Human-readable description of the event in Spanish.
description.example: Se generó la declaración Modelo 303 del segundo trimestre de 2026.
examples: Se generó la declaración Modelo 303 del segundo trimestre de 2026.

metadata.description: Event metadata. Internal identifiers (PKs) are stripped; `*_uuid` values are preserved.

type.description: Type of actor that originated the event: `user` for a human in the internal app, `api_key` for an action performed through the public v1 API.

id.description: UUID (v7) of the actor: the user when `type=user`, or the API key when `type=api_key`.

name.description: Actor name at the time of the event: the user name or the API key name. `null` if it could not be resolved.

performed_by.description: Actor that originated the event. `{type:"user",...}` for an internal user, `{type:"api_key",...}` when performed via the public v1 API, or `null` when the event is system-generated (scheduler, periodic sweep) with no attributable actor.

TaxReportActivity.title: TaxReportActivity

TaxReportPreview.description: Preview (dry-run computation, without persisting any file) of a Modelo 303/347 for a period. Lets the integrator validate the amounts before generating the final report. Amounts are expressed in euro cents (integers).

base.description: Accumulated taxable base for that VAT rate, in cents.

cuota.description: Accumulated VAT amount for that rate, in cents.

breakdown_303.description: Breakdown by VAT rate (Modelo 303 only). Map indexed by tax rate → `{base, cuota}` in cents. Empty for Modelo 347.

totals.description: Aggregated totals of the declaration (amounts in cents).

clients_347.description: Operations with clients that exceed the Modelo 347 threshold (Modelo 347 only). Empty for Modelo 303.

partyName.description: Name or legal/business name of the client.

base.description: Total annual amount of operations, in cents.

quarters.description: Amount per quarter (quarter key → amount in cents).

suppliers_347.description: Operations with suppliers that exceed the Modelo 347 threshold (Modelo 347 only). Empty for Modelo 303.

partyName.description: Name or legal/business name of the supplier.

base.description: Total annual amount of operations, in cents.

quarters.description: Amount per quarter (quarter key → amount in cents).

invoice_count.description: Number of issued invoices considered in the period.

purchase_invoice_count.description: Number of purchase invoices considered in the period.

warnings.description: Non-blocking warnings detected during the computation (e.g. invoices with incomplete data).

warning_codes.description: Stable machine-readable codes paired one-to-one (same index) with `warnings`. Branch on these instead of matching the Spanish text; unknown codes should fall back to the corresponding `warnings` entry.

TaxReportPreview.title: TaxReportPreview

TaxReportStats.description: Aggregated summary of the history of tax reports generated by the authenticated company: totals by type, by format, accumulated size and current fiscal period. Returned by `GET /v1/tax_reports/stats`.

by_type.description: Report count by type. Covers every declaration type, so the three values add up to `total_reports`.

total_size_bytes.description: Accumulated size (bytes) of all generated files.

TaxReportStats.title: TaxReportStats

TaxStats.description: Aggregated KPIs over the company tax catalog (includes global system taxes). Breakdown por `type` y por `external_reference` AEAT.

total.description: Total taxes visible to the company (system + custom).

system_count.description: Taxes from the global system catalog (`is_system=true`).

by_aeat_code.description: Tax count by AEAT `external_reference`. The `"(null)"` key groups taxes without an assigned AEAT code.

TaxStats.title: TaxStats

TaxTotals.description: Aggregated totals of a set of lines. Returned by `POST /v1/taxes/calculate-totals`. Total formula: `subtotal + total_vat + total_surcharge − total_retention`.

subtotal.description: Sum of the taxable bases of all lines (EUR).

total_vat.description: Sum of the VAT of all lines.

total_surcharge.description: Sum of the equivalence surcharge of all lines.

total_retention.description: Sum of the withholding (IRPF) of all lines.

total.description: Total general.

lines.description: Calculated breakdown for each received line, in the same order.

TaxTotals.title: TaxTotals

TaxTotalsLine.description: Calculated breakdown of a single line within `POST /v1/taxes/calculate-totals`.

subtotal.description: Taxable base of the line (quantity × price − discount).

surcharge_amount.description: Equivalence surcharge amount of the line.

total.description: Total of the line (subtotal + vat + surcharge − retention).

TaxTotalsLine.title: TaxTotalsLine

TaxUsage.description: Desglose del uso de un tax across bounded contexts. Permite decidir si es seguro borrar o desactivar un tax (`in_use=false` ⇒ delete seguro).

total_count.description: Aggregate sum of the 6 keys in `used_by`.

used_by.description: Count by consumer BC. Excludes `purchase_invoice_lines` (no FK) and `recurring_invoices` (JSON lines).

TaxUsage.title: TaxUsage

TeamAbsenceCalendar.description: The monthly team absence calendar for the Control Horario (time tracking) module: for a given year and month, every active employee with their approved absences of that month (each coloured by its absence type) plus the public holidays that apply, kept separate from the absences. A computed resource with no entity identity: it is keyed by company + year/month and never exposes an `id`.

members.description: Active employees of the team, each with their approved absences overlapping the month.

absences.description: Approved absences of the employee overlapping the month.

color.description: Hex color `#RRGGBB` of the absence type, used to render it on the calendar.

status.description: Status of the absence (always `approved` on the calendar).

holidays.description: Public holidays that apply to the team during the month.

name.description: Name of the holiday.

scope.description: Scope of the holiday: national, regional (autonomous community) or local.

TeamAbsenceCalendar.title: TeamAbsenceCalendar

TeamTimeBalanceRow.description: A single row of the team time balance summary: the monthly totals of one active employee for the Control Horario (time tracking) module.

total_expected_minutes.description: Total expected working minutes of the month.

total_worked_minutes.description: Total worked minutes of the month.

total_overtime_minutes.description: Total overtime minutes of the month.

TeamTimeBalanceRow.title: TeamTimeBalanceRow

TeamTimeBalanceSummary.description: The team time balance summary (manager view) for a month for the Control Horario (time tracking) module. A computed resource with no entity identity: it is keyed by company + month and holds one row per active employee with their monthly totals. Totals are in minutes.

employees.description: One row per active employee with their monthly totals.

TeamTimeBalanceSummary.title: TeamTimeBalanceSummary

TimeBalance.description: The time balance of an arbitrary period (`from`/`to`) of an employee for the Control Horario (time tracking) module. A computed resource with no entity identity: it is keyed by employee + period, so it exposes `employee_id` (UUID v7) and never an `id`. It is the same contract the monthly close reuses over closed periods. Totals are in minutes; `days` is the daily breakdown.

employee_id.description: UUID v7 of the employee the balance belongs to.

total_expected_minutes.description: Total expected working minutes of the period (holidays and approved absences already discounted).

total_worked_minutes.description: Total worked minutes of the period.

total_overtime_minutes.description: Total overtime minutes of the period.

TimeBalance.title: TimeBalance

TimeCorrection.description: A time entry correction request for the Control Horario (time tracking) module (RD-ley 8/2019). A correction is an append-only entry that references the original time entry without mutating it (analogous to a corrective invoice); its status is derived from the ledger — there is no status column. The workflow is request → approve/reject, always resolved by a manager and never self-approved.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the correction request, a UUID v7 (e.g. `01931b3e-7c4a-7f2e-9a8b-3c5d6e7f8a9b`).

status.description: Derived workflow state: `pending` (awaiting resolution), `approved` or `rejected`.

time_entry_id.description: UUID v7 of the original time entry the correction refers to.

employee_id.description: UUID v7 of the employee the corrected entry belongs to.

requested_by_id.description: UUID v7 of the user who requested the correction.

resolved_by_id.description: UUID v7 of the user who approved or rejected the request; `null` while it is still pending.

reason.description: Reason supplied with the request (or the rejection); `null` if none.
reason.example: El fichaje de salida se registró con 30 minutos de retraso.
examples: El fichaje de salida se registró con 30 minutos de retraso.

proposed.description: Map of the proposed values of the correction (shape depends on `kind`).

resolved_at.description: When the request was resolved (ISO 8601); `null` while it is still pending.

TimeCorrection.title: TimeCorrection

TimeEntry.description: A single entry of the immutable time record ledger (a clock event) for the Control Horario (time tracking) module. Every clock-in, pause, resume and clock-out — live or retroactive — is an entry chained by fingerprint. The workday state is derived from these entries; there is no session table. Fingerprints are never exposed.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the time entry, a UUID v7 (e.g. `01931b3e-7c4a-7f2e-9a8b-3c5d6e7f8a9b`).

employee_id.description: UUID v7 of the employee the entry belongs to.

entry_type.description: Type of clock event: `clock_in` (opens a work span), `pause_start`, `pause_end` or `clock_out` (closes the span).

occurred_at.description: When the clock event happened (ISO 8601). For retroactive entries this is the past instant supplied by the manager.

recorded_at.description: When the entry was appended to the ledger (ISO 8601).

source.description: Origin of the entry: `web` or `mobile` (live self-service) or `manual` (retroactive entry recorded by a manager).

is_retroactive.description: Whether the entry was recorded retroactively (a manual entry by a manager) rather than clocked live.

reason.description: Reason for the retroactive entry; `null` for live entries.

TimeEntry.title: TimeEntry

TimeRecordChainValidation.description: Result of recomputing and verifying the SHA-256 hash chain (`huella`) of your company time record ledger without mutating data. Returned by `GET /v1/time-entries/chain/validate`. Fingerprints are never exposed.

is_valid.description: Indicates whether the hash chain is intact.

total_records.description: Total number of time record entries considered.

first_invalid_record_id.description: UUID (v7) of the first invalid entry, or `null` if the chain is intact.

TimeRecordChainValidation.title: TimeRecordChainValidation

TimeTrackingSettings.description: The per-company time tracking configuration for the Control Horario module: the overtime computation basis and thresholds, the rounding tolerance and the forgotten-clock-in reminder settings. The public `id` is the UUID v7 of the settings row, or `null` until the first PUT materialises it.

id.description: UUID v7 of the settings row, or `null` while the company has not materialised it yet (the first PUT creates the row).

overtime_basis.description: Overtime computation basis: `weekly` aggregates the week, `daily` computes per day.

overtime_daily_threshold_minutes.description: Daily overtime threshold in minutes, or `null` to derive it from the schedule.

overtime_weekly_threshold_minutes.description: Weekly overtime threshold in minutes, or `null` to derive it from the schedule.

overtime_tolerance_minutes.description: Rounding tolerance for overtime in minutes.

clock_in_reminder_enabled.description: Whether the forgotten clock-in reminder is enabled.

clock_in_reminder_grace_minutes.description: Grace minutes after the planned start time before reminding.

TimeTrackingSettings.title: TimeTrackingSettings

employee_ids.description: Employee IDs (UUID v7) whose policy assignment is removed.

employee_id.description: Employee ID (UUID v7) whose assignment is removed.

effective_to.description: Assignment effective end date (Y-m-d); defaults to today when omitted.

name.description: Absence policy name.

allowance_days.description: Days allotted per year (positive; the domain requires a value when the allowance is `limited`).

absence_type_ids.description: Absence type IDs (UUID v7) associated (when provided, replaces the association).

name.description: Absence type name.

is_paid.description: Whether the absence is paid (the employee is compensated for the period).

requires_approval.description: Whether requesting this absence requires a manager's approval.

measurement_unit.description: Unit in which the absence is measured: `days` or `hours`.

color.description: Type color for the calendar, in `#RRGGBB` hexadecimal format.

visibility.description: Who can see the type: `everyone` or `managers_only`.

UpdateAccountPersonalizationRequest.description: Partial update of the account personalization; only the fields present in the body are applied. `language` is one of `es`, `en`, `ca`; `pdf_template` is a template slug; `accent_color` is a `#RRGGBB` hex color. Values outside the catalog return 422 with the accepted values.

language.description: Account issuing language (es, en or ca).

pdf_template.description: Invoice PDF template (slug from the template catalog).

UpdateAccountPersonalizationRequest.title: UpdateAccountPersonalizationRequest

name.description: New human-readable name. Omit it to keep the current one; it cannot be sent empty.

description.description: New description. Send it empty to clear the current one; omit it to keep it.

scope.description: Scope of the automation. It is immutable: send it to state the one the rule already has, or omit it. Sending a different one is rejected and the rule is left untouched.

trigger_type.description: New trigger, in `resource.action` form. Omit it to keep the current one. Must belong to the catalog visible to the company.

conditions.description: New condition tree. An empty object means "no condition" (the rule runs on every event); omit the key to keep the current conditions.

actions.description: New ordered list of actions, replacing the current ones. Omit it to keep them.

UpdateClientRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/clients/{uuid}.

Partial PUT update: all fields are `sometimes`. If not sent, the handler
keeps the current value. If sent as `null`, the field is cleared
(when the domain allows it).

Accepts the same fields as `CreateClientRequest` V1 (see docblock there).
The validation of domain invariants (XOR `tax_id`/`alternative_id`,
direct_debit ⇒ default bank account, billing_emails without duplicates) is
performed by the `Client` aggregate. The typed exceptions propagate to the
`ExceptionRenderer` with the canonical v1 envelope.

type.description: Alternative identifier type from the AEAT L7 catalog. Legacy aliases (`tax_id_foreign`/`national_id`) are accepted on input for backward compatibility.

UpdateClientRequest.title: UpdateClientRequest

UpdateCompanyV1Request.description: Partial update of a managed child company profile (business name, fiscal address, contact details). Omitted fields keep their current value; send `""` to clear a field. `country_aeat_zone` is derived from the postal code, and `tax_id` is immutable after creation (sending it returns 422).

name.description: Trade name of the child company (1-255 characters).

business_name.description: Legal/registered business name of the child company.

email.description: Contact email of the child company.

UpdateCompanyV1Request.title: UpdateCompanyV1Request

UpdateConnectedAccountRequest.description: Update a connected Stripe account (multi-store). All fields are optional with merge semantics (an omitted field is left unchanged): `name`, `series_id` (auto-invoicing series UUID; `null` clears it back to the company default), `simplified_threshold_cents` (0-300000), `autoinvoicing_enabled`, `require_nif`, `refunds_enabled` and `subscription_autoinvoicing_enabled`.
UpdateConnectedAccountRequest.title: UpdateConnectedAccountRequest

UpdateDeliveryNotePublicLinkRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/delivery_notes/{uuid}/public-link.

Required body: `action` ∈ {revoke, activate, extend, reset}. `extend_days`
is required when `action=extend`.
UpdateDeliveryNotePublicLinkRequest.title: UpdateDeliveryNotePublicLinkRequest

UpdateDeliveryNoteRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/delivery_notes/{uuid}.

Partial update: omitted fields are kept. Only allowed when
the delivery note is in `draft` status (the controller maps the
transition exception to 422 `invalid_status_transition`).

vehicle_plate.description: Licence plate of the vehicle used for the delivery (up to 20 characters).

UpdateDeliveryNoteRequest.title: UpdateDeliveryNoteRequest

contract_hours.description: Weekly contracted hours (greater than 0 and up to 168).

ccaa.description: Spanish autonomous community or city (ISO 3166-2:ES) used to localise public holidays.

tax_id.description: Spanish fiscal identifier (NIF/NIE) of the employee (optional).

job_title.description: Role or position of the employee (optional).

external_id.description: External integration key (ERP/CRM), unique per company

UpdateInvoicePublicLinkRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/invoices/{uuid}/public-link.

`SchemaName` sets a unique, clean OpenAPI schema name
(`UpdateInvoicePublicLinkRequest`), consistent with Quote/Proforma/DeliveryNote
for the same operation, without renaming the class.
UpdateInvoicePublicLinkRequest.title: UpdateInvoicePublicLinkRequest

line_type.description: Kind of line: `NORMAL` (default) for an ordinary line of your own operation, or `SUPLIDO` for a DISBURSEMENT — an amount you paid in the name and on behalf of the client and now re-invoice at cost, which stays out of the taxable base (art. 78.Tres.3 LIVA). Replacing the lines of a draft re-applies the same rules, so keep the field when you resend a line you read from the invoice: sending it as `NORMAL` (or omitting it) turns the disbursement into an ordinary taxable line and changes the invoice amount.

source_invoice_reference.description: Reference of the supporting document that originated the disbursement — the receipt or fee number issued by the public body (up to 100 characters). REQUIRED when `line_type` is `SUPLIDO`; leave it out on a normal line.

source_invoice_ids.description: Optional traceability of a disbursement: list of IDs (UUID v7) of your own purchase invoices that back it. A purchase invoice of another company is rejected with 422.

unit.description: Unit of measure printed next to the quantity on the document (`hours`, `kg`, `units`, …), up to 20 characters. Presentation only: free text, no closed catalog and no fiscal effect.

exemption_reason_text.description: Free-text wording of the exemption provision of this line (up to 255 characters), printed under the line description to satisfy the mention required by art. 6.1.j of Royal Decree 1619/2012 when the catalogued cause does not cover it.

line_total.description: Optional CHECKSUM of the line total. When sent, it is compared against the total this API computes and the request is rejected with 422 (`line_total_checksum_mismatch`, with the expected and received values in `error.details`) when they differ by more than one cent. Never stored and never returned.

UpdatePriceListRequest.description: Public REST API v1 — update a price list.
UpdatePriceListRequest.title: UpdatePriceListRequest

manage_stock.description: Whether this product takes part in document-driven stock movements: with `true`, issuing or receiving a document that includes it moves its stock automatically and the movement is recorded in the stock ledger. It only takes effect if your company also has stock management enabled; absent or `null` means `false`.

currency.description: Product amounts are read-only EUR: only `EUR` (or absence/null) is accepted.

external_id.description: Third-party integration key from your ERP/CRM. Partial update: an absent value is preserved. Free-form, up to 100 characters; unique per company.

stock.description: Quantity for the operation, in the product base unit (up to 4 decimals).

operation.description: How `stock` applies: `set` replaces the balance (default), `increase` adds, `decrease` subtracts. `add`/`subtract` are accepted aliases. A manual decrease below zero fails with 422.

variant_id.description: Optional variant of this product whose OWN balance receives the adjustment (the variant must belong to the product and manage its own stock). Absent → the product base stock.

base_price_override.description:
Precio propio de la variante POR UNIDAD BASE. `null` = la variante
no altera el precio del producto.

unit_cost_override.description: Coste propio de la variante POR UNIDAD BASE.

stock.description: Own balance of the variant, in the product base unit (up to 4 decimals). Send the current balance to leave it untouched — it may be negative when delivered documents ran ahead of the incoming stock. Any other value is a manual set and must be `>= 0` (422 otherwise); to move the balance use `PUT /v1/products/{uuid}/stock` with `variant_id`.

UpdateProformaPublicLinkRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/proformas/{uuid}/public-link.

`SchemaName` disambiguates the OpenAPI schema: Quote and Proforma declare
structurally identical request bodies, so without a unique name they would
collide in `components.schemas`.
UpdateProformaPublicLinkRequest.title: UpdateProformaPublicLinkRequest

UpdateProformaRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/proformas/{uuid}.

Partial update: omitted fields are kept. Only allowed when
the proforma is in `draft` status (the controller maps the
transition exception to 422 `invalid_status_transition`).
UpdateProformaRequest.title: UpdateProformaRequest

external_id.description: External business key (integration key from your ERP/CRM). Partial update: an explicit `external_id: null` clears the key. Orthogonal to `external_invoice_number`.

custom_fields.description: Typed custom fields as `[{field, value}]`. Partial update: an explicit `custom_fields: null` empties the collection.

tax_rate.description: Per-line VAT rate (0–100). REQUIRED whenever `lines` is sent: a `PUT` replaces the whole set of lines, so omitting it would wipe the VAT the invoice already had. A purchase with no VAT is declared explicitly as `tax_rate: 0`.

retention_rate.description: Per-line IRPF retention and deductible VAT. Same shape rules as create.

surcharge_rate.description: Per-line equivalence surcharge (the legal VAT↔surcharge pair is validated) and LIVA exemption reason (closed catalog).

indirect_tax_regime.description: Per-line indirect tax regime of the supplier. Same shape rule as create (defense in depth); the real invariant lives in the domain.

Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/quotes/{uuid}/public-link.

`SchemaName` disambiguates the OpenAPI schema: Quote and Proforma declare
structurally identical request bodies, so without a unique name they would
collide in `components.schemas`.
UpdateQuotePublicLinkRequest.title: UpdateQuotePublicLinkRequest

UpdateQuoteRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/quotes/{uuid}.

Partial update: omitted fields are kept. Only allowed when
the quote is in `draft` status (the controller maps the
transition exception to 422 `invalid_status_transition`).
UpdateQuoteRequest.title: UpdateQuoteRequest

UpdateRecurringInvoiceRequest.description: Partial update of a recurring invoice template; only the fields sent overwrite the current value, omitted ones are preserved. Writable fields mirror creation (`client_id`, `series_id`, `name`, `description`, `frequency`, `holiday_handling`, `start_on`, `end_on`, `notes`, `metadata`, `days_before_due`, `max_occurrences`, `email_to`, `send_automatically`, `lines[]`).
UpdateRecurringInvoiceRequest.title: UpdateRecurringInvoiceRequest

UpdateStoreV1Request.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/stores/{store}.

Partial update of the settings of a connected store: every field is optional
and a field you do not send keeps its current value. The identity of the
store —its provider connection, its provider and the identifier of the remote
shop— cannot be changed here: pointing an existing store at a different shop
would keep the invoicing history of the old one.

Two fields accept an explicit `null` and it means something: `series_id: null`
goes back to the default series of your company, and `remote_base_url: null`
removes the declared address. Omitting either one leaves it untouched.
`simplified_threshold` is expressed in EUROS and capped at the legal maximum
for a simplified invoice.

name.description: Display name of the store.

series_id.description: Series (UUID v7, type invoice) the store numbers into; send `null` to go back to the default series of your company.

simplified_threshold.description: Order total, in euros, up to which the store issues a simplified invoice. Maximum 3000.00.

require_tax_id.description: Whether the buyer tax ID is required for the order to be invoiced.

prices_include_tax.description: Whether the prices of the store already include taxes.

autoinvoicing_enabled.description: Whether paid orders are invoiced automatically.

autosend_enabled.description: Whether the invoice is emailed to the buyer automatically.

remote_base_url.description: Base address of the remote shop; send `null` to remove it. Checked against the outbound policy of your company.

environment.description: Environment the store reports as: `live` invoices for real, `test` discards with a typed reason.

authorize_remote_host.description: Authorize the host of `remote_base_url` as an outbound destination in the same call.

UpdateStoreV1Request.title: UpdateStoreV1Request

UpdateStripeAutoinvoicingConfigRequest.description: Update the Stripe auto-invoicing configuration. `enabled` toggles auto-invoicing; `series_id` (UUID, nullable) sets the series for auto-created invoices (`null` uses the company default); `simplified_threshold_cents` (0-300000), `require_nif`, `refunds_enabled` and `subscription_autoinvoicing_enabled` are optional partial fields.
UpdateStripeAutoinvoicingConfigRequest.title: UpdateStripeAutoinvoicingConfigRequest

UpdateSupplierRequest.description:
Public REST API v1 — PUT /v1/suppliers/{uuid}.

Partial PUT update: all fields are `sometimes`. If not sent, the
handler keeps the current value. If sent as `null`, the field is
cleared (when the domain allows it).

Accepts the same fields as `CreateSupplierRequest` V1 (see docblock there).
The validation of domain invariants (XOR `tax_id`/`alternative_id`,
direct_debit ⇒ default bank account, billing_emails without duplicates,
IBAN format, metadata limits) is performed by the `Supplier` aggregate and
the VOs. The typed exceptions propagate to the `ExceptionRenderer` with the
canonical v1 envelope.

iban.description: Legacy alias for the whole `bank_accounts` collection, not a single field within it: sending it REPLACES every bank account the supplier has with the single one you provide, so any other account already registered is removed. To keep several accounts, send the full `bank_accounts` array instead; to leave the accounts untouched, omit both fields. If you send both, `bank_accounts` wins and `iban` is ignored.

Legacy alias for the whole `bank_accounts` collection, not a single field within it: sending it REPLACES every bank account the supplier has with the single one you provide, so any other account already registered is removed. To keep several accounts, send the full `bank_accounts` array instead; to leave the accounts untouched, omit both fields. If you send both, `bank_accounts` wins and `iban` is ignored.

type.description: Alternative identifier type from the AEAT L7 catalog. Legacy aliases (`tax_id_foreign`/`national_id`) are accepted on input for backward compatibility.

UpdateSupplierRequest.title: UpdateSupplierRequest

customer_visible_label.description: Custom label for this tax shown to the customer on documents (e.g. "IVA 21% incluido"). Up to 200 characters.

valid_until.description: End date of the tax validity window (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Must be on or after `valid_from`.

linked_surcharge_taxes_id.description: FK to the linked equivalence-surcharge tax; `null` unlinks it. UUID v7 value referencing the global `taxes` catalog.

default_for_documents.description: Sets this tax as the default per document type. Object with optional booleans: `invoice`, `quote`, `delivery_note`, `proforma`, `purchase_invoice`, `recurring_invoice`.

overtime_daily_threshold_minutes.description: Daily overtime threshold in minutes (null = derive from the schedule).

overtime_weekly_threshold_minutes.description: Weekly overtime threshold in minutes (null = derive from the schedule).

clock_in_reminder_enabled.description: Whether the missed clock-in reminder is enabled.

clock_in_reminder_grace_minutes.description: Grace minutes after the scheduled time before reminding.

name.description: Weekly schedule name.

mode.description: Schedule mode: `validated` (assumed fulfilled) or `real_clocking` (computed from real clock entries).

week_pattern.description: Full weekly pattern: list of days with their time ranges.

day.description: Day of the week in ISO 8601 format (1 Monday .. 7 Sunday).

ranges.description: Time ranges for the day (empty = rest day).

end.description: Range end time (HH:MM; 24:00 is allowed as end of workday).

certificate_file.description: The digital certificate file in PKCS#12 format (`.p12` or `.pfx`).

Public REST API v1 — POST /v1/products/{uuid}/gallery.

WeeklySchedule.description: A fixed weekly work schedule for the Control Horario (time tracking) module. Defines, per weekday, the expected time ranges (from which the expected hours and the planned start time are derived). Its `mode` decides how balances are computed downstream: `validated` (the period is assumed fulfilled unless an exception) or `real_clocking` (only real clock-ins count).

id.description: Opaque identifier of the work schedule, a UUID v7 (e.g. `01931b3e-7c4a-7f2e-9a8b-3c5d6e7f8a9b`).

name.description: Human-readable name of the schedule (e.g. `Jornada partida`).

mode.description: How the schedule computes balances: `validated` (period assumed fulfilled unless an exception) or `real_clocking` (only real clock-ins count).

week_pattern.description: Weekly pattern: one entry per configured weekday with its ordered, non-overlapping time ranges. A weekday absent from the list (or with an empty `ranges`) is a rest day.

ranges.description: Ordered, non-overlapping time ranges worked that day (empty = rest day).

weekly_hours.description: Total weekly hours derived from the sum of all time ranges in the pattern.

status.description: Lifecycle status: `active` (assignable) or `archived` (retired from use).

WeeklySchedule.title: WeeklySchedule

WooCommerceConnectionCheck.description: The outcome of testing the connection with one of your connected WooCommerce stores. The public `id` is the UUID (v7) of the STORE that was tested, so you can tell which shop this diagnosis is about. Nothing is stored: this resource is a diagnosis, not a record. Read `reachable` and `credential_accepted` together — `reachable: false` means the shop did not answer, while `reachable: true` with `credential_accepted: false` means it answered and rejected the credential — and read `failure_code` for the concrete cause, which is what tells «your key is not valid» apart from «your REST API is not published».

id.description: UUID (v7) of the store that was tested. Public identity (KEY `id`).

object.description: Stripe-like discriminator. Always `woocommerce_connection_check` for this resource.

reachable.description: Whether the shop answered at all. `false` covers a timeout, a transport failure, a 5xx from the merchant hosting and a destination your company has not authorised for outbound traffic.

credential_accepted.description: Whether the shop accepted the consumer key and secret. Always `false` when `reachable` is `false`: we never got to ask.

store_version.description: WooCommerce version the shop reports, or `null` when it does not report one. Informational: nothing is gated on it.

api_version.description: WordPress version the shop reports, or `null` when it does not report one. WooCommerce does not publish any REST API version of its own — the version this connector speaks (`wc/v3`) is fixed on our side, not something the shop reports — so this field carries the version of WordPress, which is what serves `/wp-json/`, decides whether the route exists depending on the permalink setting and therefore explains most failures of this surface. Informational: nothing is gated on it.

failure_code.description: Code naming the concrete cause when the check did not succeed, or `null` when it did. Today `woocommerce_store_unreachable` (the shop did not answer — the only one worth retrying), `woocommerce_credentials_rejected` (the shop rejected the credential, or it could not be used) and `woocommerce_rest_route_missing` (the shop answered but its REST API is not published, usually because WordPress permalinks are on the plain setting). Not an exhaustive enumeration: new causes may appear without a breaking change, so treat an unknown value as a failure you cannot classify.

checked_at.description: When the check ran (ISO 8601). Nothing is cached: every call tests the shop again.

WooCommerceConnectionCheck.title: WooCommerceConnectionCheck
