PayloadTooLarge.description: The packaged download you asked for is too large to build, so nothing was generated and no file was left on the server. Two catalog codes carry this status, both with `error.type: invalid_request_error`: `export_document_cap_exceeded` (the request covers more documents than the cap for that artifact allows — narrow the date range or export in batches) and `export_byte_cap_exceeded` (the artifact would weigh more than the byte cap; `error.subcode` says whether it was rejected up front from the size estimate, `before_writing`, or aborted mid-packaging, `while_writing`, in which case the partial file was deleted and nothing is served). Retrying the same request unchanged returns the same error — ask for less, do not wait. A third, unrelated code shares this status on every write operation: `payload_too_large`, raised when the REQUEST body exceeds the 1 MB limit, which is about what you send and not about the size of what you asked to build.

UnprocessableEntityIntegrationEvent.description: The integration event exists but cannot be replayed. All three cases share the code `business_rule_violation` and are told apart by `error.subcode`: `integration_event_not_parked` (it was never parked, so there is nothing to reprocess and there never will be), `integration_event_payload_purged` (it was parked, but its content was deleted when the 30-day retention window elapsed) and `integration_event_reason_not_replayable` (it is parked and still holds its content, but its discard reason would take exactly the same branch again). An event whose `is_replayable` is `true` never reaches this response.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated opaque key (up to 255 characters; UUID v7 recommended) that makes retries safe: the first response is cached and replayed for repeats without re-executing the mutation. Reusing a key with a different body returns `409 idempotency_key_reused`. See the [Idempotency guide](/guides/idempotency).

FactuareaVersion.name: Factuarea-Version
FactuareaVersion.description: Pin the API version (`YYYY-MM-DD`, Stripe-style date versioning) for this request; omit to use the key's pinned version, or the latest if none. Unsupported version → `400 unsupported_api_version`; malformed → `400 parameter_invalid_format`. The effective version is echoed in the `Factuarea-Version` response header. See the [Versioning guide](/guides/versioning).

XActiveProfile.name: X-Active-Profile
XActiveProfile.description: Operate on behalf of a child company (gestoría master key): pass its public `id` (UUID v7) and the request runs against that child's data without changing the key's scope, tier or environment (omit to use the key's own company). Invalid UUID → `400 parameter_invalid_uuid`; unknown or non-owned id → `404 profile_not_found`. See the [Acting on behalf guide](/guides/acting-on-behalf).

invoice_b2c.description: Invoice to a final consumer (no recipient tax ID; simplified invoice where applicable).

invoice_intracomunitario_bienes.description: Exempt intra-community supply of goods, `exemption_reason: E5` (art. 25 LIVA), regime 01.

invoice_con_irpf.description: Invoice with IRPF withholding per line (`retention_rate`, optional consistent `retention_rate_id`). Typical of professionals / rentals.

value.justification: Modificación de la base imponible por auto de declaración de concurso del destinatario (art. 80.Tres LIVA).

corrective_r3_incobrable.description: R3 corrective invoice (uncollectible receivables), `correction_code: R3`. Applies to full invoices F1/F3.

value.justification: Crédito total o parcialmente incobrable según los requisitos del art. 80.Cuatro LIVA (reclamación previa documentada).

corrective_r4_otras.description: R4 corrective invoice (other reasons), `correction_code: R4`, full or partial (`correction_type: partial` with `lines`). Applies to full invoices F1/F3.

value.justification: Rectificación parcial por descuento posterior a la emisión sobre una de las líneas de la factura original.

lines.description: Servicio de consultoría con descuento comercial posterior

client_b2b_es.description: Creates a Spanish company client with direct debit and a full billing address.

client_b2c_minimal.description: Creates a final-consumer client with the minimum fields (name + email).

product_physical.description: Creates a physical product with SKU, price and VAT via `tax_rate_id`.

product_service.description: Creates a service product billed per day.

supplier_es.description: Creates a service supplier with a default withholding rate.

quote_b2b_es.description: Creates a quote with one service line (21% VAT per line).

proforma_b2b_es.description: Creates a pro forma with one product line (21% VAT per line).

delivery_note_es.description: Creates a delivery note with shipping details and one product line.

recurring_invoice_monthly.description: Creates a monthly recurrence with a fixed fee (21% VAT per line).

webhook_endpoint_production.description: Creates a webhook endpoint subscribed to invoice events.

client_update_contact.description: PATCH-style update of a client: only the fields present are applied.

product_update_price.description: PATCH-style update of a product (price + status).

supplier_update_contact.description: PATCH-style update of a supplier (contact + withholding).

bulk_delete_ids.description: Body of a bulk-delete operation (list of opaque UUID v7 identifiers).

product_bulk_update_stock.description: Body of the bulk-update-stock operation (several `set`/`increment`/`decrement` lines).

document_send_email.description: Body for emailing a document (invoice, quote, pro forma, delivery note): alternative recipient (`to`), copies (`cc`/`bcc`), subject and body. All fields are optional; if `to` is omitted, the client email is used.

document_public_link_update.description: Body for configuring the public link of a document. `action` (required): `activate` · `revoke` · `reset` · `extend`. With `action: extend`, `extend_days` extends the expiry (the actual limit is enforced by the plan).

employee_create.description: Alta de empleado a jornada completa. `employment_type` (`full_time`/`part_time`), `contract_hours` (>0, ≤168), `hire_date` (`Y-m-d`) y `ccaa` (ISO 3166-2:ES) son obligatorios; `tax_id` y `job_title` son opcionales.

employee_update.description: Edición parcial (PATCH): solo los campos presentes se modifican. `hire_date` no es editable.

employee_deactivate.description: Baja (soft) de un empleado. `termination_date` (`Y-m-d`) es opcional; si se omite, se aplica la fecha de hoy.

employee_invitation_send.description: Invitación de empleado (el rol `employee` lo fija el servidor). Solo se indica el email.

time_entry_clock_in.description: Entrada de jornada. `employee_id` es el UUID v7 del empleado; `source` es `web` o `mobile`; `occurred_at` (ISO 8601) es opcional (por defecto, el instante del servidor).

time_entry_clock_out.description: Salida de jornada. Mismos campos que la entrada; `occurred_at` marca el fin de la jornada abierta.

time_entry_pause.description: Inicio de una pausa dentro de la jornada abierta.

time_entry_resume.description: Reanudación de la jornada tras una pausa.

time_entry_manual.description: Fichaje retroactivo. `started_at`/`ended_at` (ISO 8601, fin posterior al inicio) y `reason` son obligatorios; `pauses` es una lista opcional de intervalos `{start, end}`.

value.reason: El empleado olvidó fichar; jornada confirmada por su responsable.

time_correction_create.description: Solicitud de corrección de un fichaje. `kind` es `add_missing_entry`, `adjust_time` o `remove_entry`; `reason` es obligatorio. Para `adjust_time`/`add_missing_entry`, `proposed.occurred_at` (ISO 8601, no futura) es obligatorio.

value.reason: La hora de entrada real fue las 09:05, no las 09:30.

time_correction_approve.description: Aprobación de una solicitud de corrección. `note` es opcional (el aprobador no puede ser el solicitante).

value.note: Corrección verificada con el registro de acceso; se aprueba.

time_correction_reject.description: Rechazo de una solicitud de corrección. `reason` es obligatorio.

value.reason: La corrección no coincide con el registro de acceso al edificio.

monthly_time_record_close_create.description: Cierre mensual del registro de jornada. `year` (2000-2100) y `month` (1-12) del periodo a cerrar; el mes debe haber terminado.

time_tracking_settings_update.description: Configuración de control horario. `overtime_basis` es `weekly` o `daily`; los umbrales son minutos (opcionales; `null` = derivar del horario); el recordatorio de olvido de fichaje se configura con `clock_in_reminder_*`.

work_schedule_create.description: Alta de horario semanal. `mode` es `validated` (jornada validada) o `real_clocking` (fichaje real). `week_pattern` lista los días (`day` 1=lunes .. 7=domingo) con sus franjas `HH:MM`–`HH:MM` (lista vacía = descanso). Una franja puede ser flexible (`flexible: true` + `required_minutes`).

work_schedule_update.description: La actualización REEMPLAZA por completo el horario: `name`, `mode` y `week_pattern` son obligatorios (no hay actualización parcial del patrón).

work_schedule_assign.description: Asigna el horario a un empleado con vigencia efectivo-datada. `employee_id` (UUID v7) y `effective_from` (`Y-m-d`).

work_schedule_unassign.description: Cierra la asignación abierta del horario a un empleado. `effective_to` (`Y-m-d`) es opcional; si se omite, la fecha de hoy.

absence_type_create.description: Alta de tipo de ausencia. Todos los campos son obligatorios: `measurement_unit` (`days`/`hours`), `color` hexadecimal `#RRGGBB` y `visibility` (`everyone`/`managers_only`).

absence_type_update.description: Edición parcial: cada campo omitido conserva su valor actual.

absence_policy_create.description: Alta de política de ausencia. `allowance_type` es `limited` o `unlimited`; `allowance_days` es obligatorio solo si es `limited`. `accrual_method` es `annual` o `monthly`. `absence_type_ids` es la lista (posiblemente vacía) de UUID v7 de los tipos asociados.

absence_policy_update.description: Edición parcial: cada campo omitido conserva su valor. Si `absence_type_ids` viene, reemplaza por completo los tipos asociados.

absence_policy_assign.description: Asigna (en lote) la política a uno o varios empleados. `employee_ids` es una lista de UUID v7 con al menos un elemento.

absence_policy_unassign.description: Retira (en lote) la asignación de la política. `employee_ids` es una lista de UUID v7 con al menos un elemento.

absence_policy_carryover.description: Configura el arrastre de saldo no consumido. `carryover_type` es `none`/`capped`/`unlimited`; `carryover_max_days` es obligatorio con `capped`. El par de caducidad (`carryover_expiry_month` + `carryover_expiry_day`) es coherente: o vienen los dos o ninguno.

absence_request_create.description: Da de alta una solicitud de ausencia. En v1 `employee_id` es OBLIGATORIO (UUID v7). `absence_type_id` es el UUID v7 del tipo; el rango `start_date`/`end_date` va en `Y-m-d` con fin ≥ inicio; `note` es opcional.

absence_request_approve.description: Aprobación de una solicitud de ausencia. `note` es opcional; el aprobador no puede ser el propio solicitante.

value.note: Aprobada; saldo suficiente para el periodo solicitado.

absence_request_reject.description: Rechazo de una solicitud de ausencia. `reason` es obligatorio.

value.reason: Coincide con el cierre trimestral; por favor, solicita otras fechas.

post.description: Factuarea POSTs this body to every subscribed endpoint when a subscribed event occurs. The receiver verifies the `Factuarea-Signature` HMAC header and SHALL respond with a 2xx status to acknowledge the delivery; any other status (or a timeout) is retried with exponential backoff.

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: Always `application/json`.

parameters.name: Factuarea-Signature
parameters.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature of the raw request body, used to verify the delivery is authentic. Format `t=<timestamp>,v1=<signature>` (and `v0=<signature>` while a rotated secret is still valid).

parameters.name: Factuarea-Event-Id
parameters.description: Stable identifier of the event (UUID v7). Identical across redeliveries of the same event.

parameters.name: Factuarea-Event-Type
parameters.description: Type of the delivered event, e.g. `invoice.paid`.

parameters.name: Factuarea-Delivery-Id
parameters.description: Identifier of this specific delivery attempt (UUID v7). Differs on each redelivery of the same event.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Standard idempotency header. Its value is identical to `Factuarea-Event-Id` (the stable UUID v7 of the event), so a receiver can deduplicate redeliveries using the industry-standard header.

200.description: The receiver acknowledged the delivery. Any 2xx status is treated as success; the body is ignored.

4XX.description: The receiver rejected the delivery. Factuarea retries with exponential backoff until the endpoint is disabled.

5XX.description: The receiver failed to process the delivery. Factuarea retries with exponential backoff.
